peer_comments.body: The `is_root_model` check uses `in` substring matching (`ROOT_MODEL_FULLNAME in base.fullname`) rather than exact equality (`base.fullname == ROOT_MODEL_FULLNAME`). This could produce false positives if a class exists whose fully-qualified name contains `'pydantic.root_model.RootModel'` as a substring (e.g. `'some.pydantic.root_model.RootModel'`). All other similar checks in this file use `==` for exact matching (e.g. `base.fullname == BASESETTINGS_FULLNAME`). Change to `base.fullname == ROOT_MODEL_FULLNAME`.
peer_comments.rationale: Compare with the `is_settings` check on the very next line: `any(base.fullname == BASESETTINGS_FULLNAME for base in info.mro[:-1])`. The inconsistency is clear in the diff at line 433.

peer_comments.body: If `args` is empty (i.e. the RootModel subclass has no fields at all), `args[0]` will raise an `IndexError`. This can happen when the plugin processes a bare `class Pets1(RootModel[List[str]]): pass` — after the `is_root_model and lhs.name != 'root'` guard in `collect_fields`, the inherited `root` field should be present, but if `found_fields` is empty for any reason, this line will crash. Add an `if args` guard before accessing `args[0]`.
peer_comments.rationale: The test module `Pets1` (lines 6-7 of `tests/mypy/modules/root_models.py`) has `pass` and relies entirely on the inherited `root` field being propagated into `args`. If that inheritance path ever yields no fields, this code will raise.

peer_comments.body: `error_extra_fields_on_root_model` takes `api: CheckerPluginInterface`, but `collect_fields` (the only caller) receives `self._api` which is typed as `SemanticAnalyzerPluginInterface`. These are different interfaces — `CheckerPluginInterface` is for the type-checking phase, while `SemanticAnalyzerPluginInterface` is for the semantic analysis phase. This type mismatch may cause a runtime `AttributeError`. The other similar functions called from `collect_fields` (e.g. `error_untyped_fields` at line 1094) correctly accept `SemanticAnalyzerPluginInterface`. Change the parameter type to `SemanticAnalyzerPluginInterface`.
peer_comments.rationale: All other `error_*` functions called from semantic-analysis-phase methods (like `collect_fields`) use `SemanticAnalyzerPluginInterface` (e.g. `error_untyped_fields`, `error_invalid_config_value`, `error_required_dynamic_aliases`). The `CheckerPluginInterface` is used by checker-phase functions like `error_from_attributes`.

peer_comments.body: There is only one output file (for mypy 1.0.1 with `mypy-plugin.ini`). Looking at other test cases (e.g. `custom_constructor.py`, `generics.py`), each has output files for multiple mypy versions. If outputs differ between versions, missing output files will cause tests to fail or silently skip version-specific behavior. Confirm whether output files for other mypy versions (e.g. 0.971, 1.1.1) are intentionally omitted.
peer_comments.rationale: Other modules in the test suite have counterpart output directories for each supported mypy version. Only a single version directory is added in this PR.

human_comments.author: dmontagu
human_comments.body:
You can run `make test-mypy-update-all` — note that it will take a while as it clears cache, and runs all mypy tests (which already aren't fast) for all versions of mypy one at a time.

You could probably get it to run faster by commenting out everything but the `root_models.py` file here and dropping the `rm -rf tests/mypy/outputs` from the command (or just reverting all the deletions it will do).
